Temos todos os ingredientes necessários para começar bem o dia!.

programme.title: Mulheres Em Foco - Ep. 170
programme.desc: A vida da mulher é cheia de múltiplas tarefas e papéis. E é tudo isso que será falado e conhecido no Programa Mulheres em Foco.Todos os dias, vamos conversar sobre temas do universo feminino, desde o lar, à família, à moda, com entrevistas e uma abordagem real sobre a mulher de hoje em dia. O programa também dá voz às mulheres que conheceram o Poder da Fé e hoje são verdadeiros exemplos de transformação.

programme.title: Palavra Amiga Bispo Macedo - Ep. 197
programme.desc: Diariamente o Bispo Edir Macedo traz uma mensagem de fé e fortalecimento espiritual para todas as pessoas que sofrem e enfrentam dificuldades na vida. O poder da fé é vasto e é necessário que seja dado a conhecer, por isso acompanhe este momento que poderá fazer toda a diferença, revelando a prova da existência dos milhares de casos de superação.

programme.title: Heartland T6 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: A série 'Heartland' acompanha a vida da família Fleming-Bartlett na gestão de um rancho de cavalos no Canadá, focando na jovem Amy, que, após a morte da mãe, assume o dom de curar e reabilitar cavalos. Ela lida com os desafios da adolescência, familiares e financeiros para salvar o rancho, enquanto a sua irmã Lou tenta ajudá-la com a sua visão de negócios.

programme.title: Saindo Da Crise - Ep. 198

programme.title: Problemas Soluções - Ep. 198
programme.desc: Dificuldades e obstáculos todos teremos de enfrentar ao longo da vida, mas por vezes, estes são de tal forma graves que parecem não ter solução. Seja uma doença, um problema na família, no casamento, na vida financeira ou espiritual.Por vezes, as forças desaparecem e não parece haver luz ao fundo do túnel. Mas, acredite que para qualquer tipo de problema existe uma solução.

programme.title: Saindo Da Depressão - Ep. 198
programme.desc: A depressão, para além de ser a doença do século, afeta milhões de pessoas em todo o mundo. Sintomas como tristeza constante, desânimo, falta de vontade para viver são sentimentos de quem sofre com depressão. Sendo este um problema sério com urgente resolução, o programa Saindo da Depressão tem sido a alavanca de mudança para inúmeras pessoas que superaram esta patologia, que infelizmente ainda mata.

programme.title: Milagres De Jesus - Ep. 142
programme.desc: Na Bíblia vêm descritos os mais extraordinários milagres. Situações que careciam de uma mudança e que são bastante comparáveis aos problemas de hoje em dia. Para todos os problemas, a fé tem um desfecho essencial, por isso veja neste programa, como os Milagres Acontecem. Os milagres existem e este programa é a prova disso mesmo.

programme.title: Cat Wars: Lion vs. Cheetah - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Big Cat Wars will showcase an incredibly unique stock footage sequence of a moment when a predator on predator conflict turns deadly. The clip of lion vs cheetah is a nail biting moment that will shock, but in the end will shed new light on the mysterious relationship between these extraordinary big cats and their life-and-death struggle for survival.

programme.title: Cheetahs Up Close With Bertie Gregory - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Bertie arrives in the Serengeti as the spectacular wildebeest migration kicks off. He’s here to film the fastest land animal on Earth: the cheetah. He gets close to a mother caring for her tiny cubs and a young group of males executing phenomenal hunts as a team, and learns about the unexpected challenges the species face.

programme.title: Serengeti Speed Queen - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Nzuri is the Speed Queen of the Serengeti - but being fast isn’t enough. She’s constantly bullied by hyenas on the grassland and hunted by lions in the marsh. When two of her cubs are killed, the family is exiled to the transition forest. There, she learns to adapt her hunting methods and adds strategy to speed in order to outwit her enemies and steer her remaining cubs successfully to adulthood.

programme.title: Rare Cat Skills - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Rare wild cats showcase extraordinary skills for survival. Over millennia, each species evolved with unique adaptations to suit their environment. The Pallas’s cat blends into China’s rocky steppes, the black panther hunts in India’s forest shadows, and the snow leopard scales icy Himalayan peaks. Every camouflage trick, extraordinary skill and heightened sense are their keys to survival.

programme.title: Iberia's Woodlands T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: The forests of the Iberian Peninsula in Europe’s southwest corner are home to some of the most unusual animals on Earth. Every species must fight to survive in these savage lands, but the spring rains are one of the greatest gifts of the year. In this brief window of time, animals seek out the precise breeding conditions that will give their species the best chance of surviving another generation.

programme.desc: In the Highlands, Charlotte and Petal go in search of new territory and potential mates.Over in the Flatlands, Buttercup and her siblings must figure out how to survive without parental supervision.

programme.desc: For the Prairie Dogs in northern New Mexico, winter has nearly come. In the Highlands, Carl and the pups prepare for hibernation, but an unlikely alliance of deadly predators creates a heightened threat for every dog in the territory.

programme.desc: In the Southern Indian and Pacific Oceans, Crozet, Heard, Auckland and Enderby, Macquarie and Campbell Islands are home to some of the rarest Sub-Antarctic animals on Earth: Royal and Yellow-eyed Penguins, New Zealand Sea Lion and the Southern Right Whales.

programme.desc: Africa is a land of giants. Its powerful rivers sculpt the earth and form impressive valleys and waterways home to many imposing and powerful inhabitants. These are the rivers where massive elephants and hippos live, feed and drink and where ancient crocodiles hunt and breed.

programme.title: Frozen Islands T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: In the Southern Atlantic and Indian Oceans South Georgia, Bouvet, Marion and Crozet Islands are home to some of the world's largest populations of Seal and Penguins. These creatures, superbly adapted to life in a freezing ocean need to come ashore breed. They are followed by the hunters: Killer Whales..

programme.title: Frozen Islands T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: In the Southern Indian and Pacific Oceans, Crozet, Heard, Auckland and Enderby, Macquarie and Campbell Islands are home to some of the rarest Sub-Antarctic animals on Earth: Royal and Yellow-eyed Penguins, New Zealand Sea Lion and the Southern Right Whales.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol T19 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: It’s a real dog and pony show at Pol Vet! Doc assists a young mare in an emergency foaling and Dr. Lisa treats a Great Dane with a swollen face. Goats with coccidia fight for their lives and a stray cat fights treatment. A cat is full of gas; a pig has lost his potbelly. A Black Lab is brought in with a stinker of a problem. Rowdy angus cattle get pregnancy checks and winter arrives in Michigan.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol T19 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: When the temperature drops, caseloads rise, and Pol Veterinary Services gets slammed with flurries and furries. After hours, Dr. Lisa fights to save Pearl’s mangled leg. The sweet Lab’s housemate is rushed to the clinic days later with labor complications! Fair pigs and a fair guinea pig receive much-needed TLC, and Dr. Pol and Dr. Brenda treat double-cow trouble at a nearby dairy.

programme.title: Snakes In The City T8 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: In this episode Simon and Sioux’s new apprentice, Mbali, gets a front row seat to a wild black mamba rescue in which the snake almost nails Simon on the ankle. The team is put to the test when they have to help capture and relocate a 10-foot crocodile from a local farm dam. Then summer has them running around in two teams to rescue two snakes in one house and another sneaky reptile stuck in someone’s roof.

programme.title: Snakes In The City T8 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Simon puts his life on the line, bagging a riled-up black mamba alone in a baking roof. As the summer heats up, Siouxsie and Mbali prove their snake skills by catching three water snakes on one call, while Simon bails a wolf snake out of the police station. The team regroup for one black mamba vs two large dogs. Mbali steps up to claim gold, catching a particularly fiesty forest cobra by the tail.

The arrival of summer marks the beginning of what will be a prolonged period of drought in the region, making survival even more difficult for the animals who call this place home. Every creature must fight for limited resources – making competition both within and between species unavoidable.

programme.title: Iberia's Woodlands T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: The forests of the Iberian Peninsula in Europe’s southwest corner are home to some of the most unusual animals on Earth. Every species must fight to survive in these savage lands, but the spring rains are one of the greatest gifts of the year. In this brief window of time, animals seek out the precise breeding conditions that will give their species the best chance of surviving another generation.

programme.title: Extraordinary Australia T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Australias coastline is a true natural wonder, encompassing a diverse range of bountiful habitats. Coastal seas and lands are realms of epic migrations, mesmerising mating rituals and high stakes battles between predator and prey. .

programme.title: Untamed Philippines T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Moving from turtles of the Palawan coast to the unique National Marine Park at Tubbataha, to meet giants, whale sharks and manta rays. We also see how people can mediate between people and wildlife as we join a snake hunting team catching and translocating a deadly Samar cobra.

programme.title: Untamed Philippines T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: We start on the tiny island of Batan, meeting a unique viper and a ubiquitous but also giant, land crab. Luzon is the main island of the Philippines. We drop in to Mindoro to see the most endangered large mammal in the Philippines, the tamaraw.

programme.title: Trials Of The Wild T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: With the arrival of spring, animals from all over the South Atlantic are suddenly converging on the Falklands. The striated cara-cara is one of the few year-round inhabitants of the islands.

programme.title: Trials Of The Wild T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Each year, monarch butterflies undertake a multi-generational migration from Mexico all the way to Canada and back again. .

programme.title: Predator V Prey T2 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: A forensic look at how wolf packs hunt prey, offering new perspectives on the way they work together to locate, isolate and bring down large bison and musk oxen. An arctic wolf pack must make a kill before the harsh winter arrives, while further south, grey wolves take on prey 10 times their size.

programme.title: Wild Arabia T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Discover Saudi Arabia’s rugged landscapes where wildlife ingeniously adapts to extreme conditions. Amid sun-scorched terrain, creatures endure searing sun, thin air, and toxic gases. Explore bone caves, and marvel at rock art depicting local fauna—deadly scorpions, raucous baboons, charming chameleons, and endangered leopards. Their resilience mirrors the harsh beauty of Saudi Arabia’s environment.

programme.title: Wild Vietnam T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Travel to Vietnam's mountainous forests to discover endangered pangolins, Asian palm civets, and the golden-headed langurs of Cat Ba Island. The recently discovered Vietnamese crocodile lizard is already vulnerable to smuggling, while the critically endangered Delacour's langurs take refuge in a nature reserve. In springtime, an astonishing diversity of butterfly species congregates in the forest.

programme.title: Wild Vietnam T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Travel to southern Vietnam's tropical habitats, home to gibbons and playful macaques, green sea turtles, and Asian black bears. programme.title: Ultimate Rivals: Cats vs Dogs - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Canines and felines have been living side by side in Africa for hundreds of thousands of years, and they've never really gotten along-not even amongst themselves. Throw the hyena into the mix and they're all nightmare neighbors? Stealing from each other; harassing each other; eating each other's young. Avoidance might be the only way to stay alive. Cats, dogs and the wild-card hyena, all jousting in a free for all for survival.

programme.title: Blood Rivals: Lion vs. Buffalo - Ep. 1
programme.desc: In Africa, no other herbivore rivals the buffalo with its brute force and collective strategy; honed over millennia in an evolutionary blood feud with the ultimate predator. For most of the year the breeding herd fends off relentless attacks from the resident lion pride. Then, when the dry season sucks water away from the grasslands, they migrate beyond the reach of the killers, but risk starvation.

programme.title: Predator V Prey T2 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: A forensic look at how polar bears hunt prey, offering new perspectives on the tactics they use to track, stalk and ambush seals, whales and walruses. We follow a mother fighting to feed her two cubs in the harsh polar extremes, and a young male driven by starvation to tackle enormous prey.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol T19 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: From fights and falls to geckos and goats, Doc and the vets save the day! A pig with a prolapse, a plethora of puppies, and an adorable vet-to-be keep things rolling. Dr. Pol mends a Dachshund after a vicious fight with another dog, Dr. Lisa assists in an emergency twin goat kidding, and Dr. Nicole removes a painful nail from a horse’s hoof. Meanwhile, the Pol family gets some exciting baby news.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol T19 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Puppies have overrun the clinic! Six litters of playful pups are given checkups. Teddy the puppy has a mysterious ailment. Dr. Lisa works to save a cat’s leg. A rat named Simba is seen by Dr. Nicole for a head tilt and Dr. Pol and Dr. Brenda help two local farms get their animals ready for breeding. The Docs at Pol Veterinary Service never stop!.

programme.title: Shark Vs Predator - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Rare and remarkable instances of predation on sharks by a variety of species, capture by both daring photographers and unlikely bystanders, have given us new insight as to how the primacy of an apex predator can be challenged. We will analyze this growing body of footage with the aid of experts in the field, shedding light on how and why these events occur.

programme.title: Malika: The Lion Queen T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Narrated by Hollywood A-Lister actress Angela Bassett and produced by the Emmy-Award-winning producers of Planet Earth II, Blue Planet, and Hostile Planet, we journey with Malika as she deals with the hardships of moving from childhood to adulthood.
